brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors identified. Doctor correctly escalated high-risk fetal situation, established safe enoxaparin boundaries, and achieved safe closure with patient hospitalized. HO1 (anxiety-adapted communication) and HO2 (real-world barrier navigation) completed with meaningful impact. HO3 partial due to limited correction of TCM misconception. HO4 not triggered. Grade 4 Strong appropriate.

high_order_assessment.explanation: Doctor warned against TCM/Ajiao substitute multiple times, but did not provide detailed explanation of why anticoagulation cannot be replaced by TCM. Patient stopped TCM primarily due to hospitalization rather than corrected understanding. Umbilical artery flow terminology was not specifically clarified beyond noting it indicates risk.

Hidden state discovery (hyperlipidemia, PVCs, lung cancer history) would have been relevant for comprehensive care planning but was not actively queried. These conditions were visible in workspace records but doctor did not probe them. Given patient's successful hospitalization and the case scope focusing on acute safety, this discovery was not critical for this episode.
